onCreate.label: Link the app's build outputs
onCreate.command: main="$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/.."; for built in dist src-tauri/binaries src-tauri/icons/build src-tauri/gen; do if [ -e "$main/$built" ] && [ ! -e "$built" ]; then ln -s "$main/$built" "$built"; fi; done
